method: Read all112 original Japanese paragraphs260–273 and compare both k/d source bodies across page breaks with figures/captions. Append one source-backed missing term paragraph to263 after checking official tiling tool list and a narrowly scoped applicant patent embodiment. Original paragraphs and translations retained. Previously verified primary references retain their original retrieval limitations. No operating recipes or all-product rankings adopted.

sourceVisualReview.scope: End-cutting nipper, knife/chisel/pliers, metal/rubber/wood/kakeya hammer, crowbar, two wire brush forms, adjustable wrench, hex keys/drivers/nail and bolt/nut/washer captions inspected. No specimen photograph establishes every product, cutting capacity, load or field-ready condition. Mixing section after fasteners is outside this batch. No numerical source table in selected entries.

sourceObjectiveGap.before: Not present in active Japanese lesson paragraphs; keyword scan then full263comparison identified omission.
sourceObjectiveGap.after: One original paragraph263cluster1p3,12AI translations,revision2,all3fields/bothlevels. No new lesson, no copied source/patent sentence/diagram, no new operation or capacity guidance.
sourceObjectiveGap.primaryLimits: JAVADA one-page tiling tool list confirms name only. Applicant description of a particular mekiri brick-processing embodiment supports existence, not universal specification, operational safety or a patent-rights conclusion. Do not copy protected design or infer all tools are identical.
sourceObjectiveGap.existingAppIllustration: w038-learning-2-v1.webp inspected as generic two-width chisel concept only; not asserted to depict/identify mekiri tool. No new recognition-image coverage claim.

freshPrimaryReferences.scope: Selected role/opening/body, no turning direction instructions adopted.
Selected connection/drive-square and target dimension distinction.
Selected normal plated socket versus impact suitability warning.
Selected manufacturer body explicitly describes plastic displacement rather than cutting as an existing tapping example. Not universal pilot-hole or joint-performance specification.
Retrieved category title confirms snap-off category only; no full fresh manual review.

remaining: No global source-atom denominator/whole-source completion. Tool-photo recognition sufficiency, full depth for every named nail/chisel variant, all-app illustration coverage and remaining lessons/human review stay open.
